title: Translate Video exports match your source video
summary: Translate Video exports match your source video's frame rate and quality, and rotated or phone videos no longer export stretched.

sections.title: Translate Video
sections.note: Exports follow the frame rate, audio and quality of the video you uploaded.

items.body: Phone videos export at their real, measured frame rate
Screen recordings up to 60 fps keep every frame
**Keep original video quality** now carries through to the export
Child organizations inherit their parent's setting
Rotated and non-MP4 uploads no longer export stretched or juddering
